mentions.name: Curio
mentions.description: A decluttering companion built on the Memoria journal platform that captures the sentiment of an object so things can be thrown away without losing the memories tied to holding them.
mentions.problem: The author's trigger-based ADHD memory means discarding an object loses the memory attached to holding it, so decluttering currently comes at the cost of losing those memories.
mentions.source_excerpt: Project: Curio - based on the platform above - helping to declutter based on capturing the sentiment of an object. My ADHD means that my memory is trigger based, and if you toss the thing, I lose the memory. I'm trying to find a way to get rid of things without losing my memory that comes from holding it in my hand.
